blocks.tamil_translation: will please him on the Day of Qiyamah” — Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ يَقُوْلُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ الْمُسَدِّدَ لَيُدْرِكُ دَرَجَةَ الصَّوَّامِ الْقَوَّامِ بِآيَاتِ اللهِ بِحُسْنِ خُلُقِهِ وَكَرَمِ ضَرِيْبَتِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “A Muslim who acts according to the Deen will, through his noble nature and beautiful character, attain the rank of the man who recites the noble Qur'an in Salah at night and fasts a great deal” — Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَامِنْ شَيْءٍ اَثْقَلُ فِي الْمِيْزَانِ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في حسن الخلق رقم:٤٧٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: (On the Day of Qiyamah) “In the scale that weighs the deeds of a Mu'min, there will be no deed heavier than good character” — Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ قَالَ: آخِرُ مَااَوْصَانِيْ بِهِ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ حِيْنَ وَضَعْتُ رِجْلِيْ فِي الْغَرْزِاَنْ قَالَ لِيْ: اَحْسِنْ خُلُقَكَ لِلنَّاسِ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الامام مالك في الموطا، ماجاء في حسن الخلق ص:٧٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: When I placed my foot in the stirrup to mount my riding animal, the last advice the Prophet ﷺ gave me was, “O Mu'adh! Make your character beautiful for the people!” — Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal
